capabilities: Import a Zotero library with metadata, collections, and local PDFs
Convert PDFs to Markdown with renderable equations, tables, and illustrations
Translate papers with paragraph-linked side-by-side comparison against the original
Browse, filter, and search papers by collection, author, or read status
Generate optional structured summaries saved as separate notes
extras: Cloud processing uploads PDFs or text to api.rectoai.uk; payments currently only via WeChat Pay in CNY; desktop only (no mobile); import is not a full Zotero backup of all item types, notes, or annotations; OCR and translation reliability vary by language and scan quality.
motivation: The author saw researchers with large Zotero libraries reading only a fraction closely, switching between PDF readers and translation tools while passages never became part of a searchable note collection.
problem: Researchers juggle a PDF reader and a translation tool, lose equation and table formatting when copying, and leave useful passages scattered outside their searchable notes.

relations.evidence: Bring your Zotero paper library into Obsidian, convert PDFs to Markdown

requires.name: Zotero (local data directory with locally available PDF attachments)
Free Recto account for cloud conversion and translation
Translation page credits (purchasable; conversion currently free)

summary: Zotero library importer that converts PDFs to Markdown with OCR and produces paragraph-linked translations for side-by-side reading.
